The cart features a cream-colored hardtop roof, a clear windshield, black tubular frame supports, and custom white graphics/decals on the body panels. It has two bench seats with black and white upholstery, a steering wheel, and a rear cargo rack. The tires appear to be all-terrain style rather than standard smooth turf tires.
